choice: retain whole-library audit; approve only individually audited Bird, Fairy, Bog and Hunter abilities
why: Copies, summons and text theft can reach definitions not present as an initial active board unit; whole-library masking plus recursive input masking preserves that closure. Unseen native IDs and unseen/missing pass3 abilities remain unsupported. Bog Jenny and Lantern are masked by ability; other Bog abilities remain intact, with Snap masked separately. Hunter Isegrim is a biggest-enemy combat selector; Ermeline ranks marked bell snapshots only for a post-fight reward. Other Hunter abilities do not select the biggest enemy.
class_scope: largest-enemy answer/target selection, not all positional debuffs, all-enemy effects or friendly-largest holder choices
